name: ai-action-bar
title: AI action bar
description: A toolbar that morphs into a one-line prompt for the agent, and back.

props.name: tools
props.description: The tool buttons shown in tools mode, each with an id, a label, an icon and an optional onSelect.

props.name: onAsk
props.description: Runs with the instruction when the person sends it.

props.name: labels
props.type: { tools?: string; ask?: string; send?: string; mode?: string }
props.description: Screen reader text with English defaults. Keys: `tools`, `ask`, `send` and `mode` (the name of the mode switch).

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: Which mode it starts in: the tool buttons or the prompt field.

a11y.text: The mode switch is a radiogroup with a roving tab stop: Tab reaches only the selected radio. The arrow keys move to the next or previous mode and wrap, Home and End jump to the first and last, and the selection follows focus. Switching with the arrows keeps focus on the radio, while a click or tap on Ask AI moves focus into the field. Enter in the field submits the form, and the send button is disabled while the field is empty.

The mode switch is a radiogroup labelled by labels.mode (Mode) with two role radio buttons that set aria-checked and take their name from labels (Tools, Ask AI). Tool buttons are named by their label, which also shows as a tooltip, and the tool icon is aria-hidden. The field is labelled by labels.ask and the send button by labels.send.

The bar is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for its layout and transform animations. The colour and press transitions on the buttons are off under reduced motion.
